description: 🚀 Team Innovex is a passionate team of technology enthusiasts participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 at Kopargaon. We aim to solve real-world challenges through coding, data analysis, AI, and innovation. Our challenge focuses on harmonizing MODIS and VIIRS satellite hotspot data to support better wildfire monitoring. We welcome creative thinkers, coders, and space enthusiasts to collaborate and build impactful solutions. 🌍🛰️
